config_entries_to_append.rationale: ENV-001 (analysis.json) — LLD config.py expects `API_CORS_ORIGINS` and `API_ENV` field names. APPEND new variants (do NOT remove the existing APP_* entries — they stay for any operator using the older convention). Pydantic-settings is case-insensitive and reads the explicit name first.
config_entries_to_append.lines_to_append:
# Sprint S1 — LLD-aligned env vars (ENV-001 resolution). Pydantic-settings reads these into Settings fields.
API_CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000
API_ENV=development
